description: Implementation of the HealthComponent class managing entity health, damage, healing, and death logic in a game, including damage modifiers, team protections, and damage accounting.

classes.name: HealthComponent
classes.description: Manages entity health, damage, healing, and death events within the game.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns health and maxHealth from another HealthComponent, scaling health proportionally.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Prepares health data for network transmission, updating client or buildable entity states.

methods.name: HandleHeal
methods.description: Heals the entity by a specified amount, not exceeding maxHealth, and adjusts damage accounts.

methods.name: HandleDamage
methods.description: Applies damage to the entity, considering protections, team damage multipliers, and death handling.

methods.name: SetHealth
methods.description: Sets the entity's current health, clamped between epsilon and maxHealth, and adjusts damage accounts.

methods.name: SetMaxHealth
methods.description: Sets the maximum health, optionally scaling current health proportionally.

methods.name: ScaleDamageAccounts
methods.description: Adjusts damage accounts proportionally when health is restored or reduced.
